# Step 10 — figures/

The exact experiment PNGs the Step 10 deliverables cite. Every figure must trace to a real
artifact under `implementation/step10/**/{results,figures,plots}`; nothing here is fabricated.
Exploration figures keep their original names; implementation-plot figures are prefixed `impl_`.

**Status: the experiment PNGs were produced on the run and exist** (matplotlib was active),
unlike Step 09. They just need copying into this folder. The **conceptual diagrams** are still
**[to close]** — they are generated by the `summary/make_*_figure.py` scripts (a human step; the
agent does not run code).

---

## How to assemble them (human step)

The experiment PNGs already exist; copy them here (from `rlPlanRevised/`):

```bash
# exploration figures
cp implementation/step10/exploration/figures/replicator_playground.png deliverables/reports/step10/figures/
cp implementation/step10/exploration/figures/game_landscape.png        deliverables/reports/step10/figures/
cp implementation/step10/exploration/figures/mini_pbt.png              deliverables/reports/step10/figures/

# implementation plots
cp implementation/step10/implementation/plots/replicator_portraits.png      deliverables/reports/step10/figures/impl_replicator_portraits.png
cp implementation/step10/implementation/plots/transitive_ratios.png         deliverables/reports/step10/figures/impl_transitive_ratios.png
cp implementation/step10/implementation/plots/league_exploitability.png     deliverables/reports/step10/figures/impl_league_exploitability.png
cp implementation/step10/implementation/plots/comparison_exploitability.png deliverables/reports/step10/figures/impl_comparison_exploitability.png
```

If you need to (re)generate the experiment PNGs first (needs `matplotlib`):

```bash
cd rlPlanRevised/implementation/step10/exploration
python replicator_playground.py       # -> figures/replicator_playground.png
python game_landscape.py               # -> figures/game_landscape.png
python mini_pbt.py                     # -> figures/mini_pbt.png

cd ../implementation
python tournament.py --config scale    # -> results/scale_results.json
python plotting.py --config scale      # -> plots/*.png
```

The conceptual-diagram PNGs are produced by the `summary/make_*_figure.py` scripts (human step):

```bash
cd rlPlanRevised/deliverables/reports/step10/summary
python make_replicator_figure.py    # -> replicator_selection.png
python make_spinning_top_figure.py  # -> spinning_top.png
python make_league_figure.py        # -> league_architecture.png
python make_egta_figure.py          # -> egta_pipeline.png
```
